verse: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
story: John writes to people who already walk with Christ, and he still tells them to speak their sins out loud.

The promise rests on character, not on our performance. If we agree with God about what we have done, He is faithful to His word and just in how He deals with it, because Christ has already borne the cost. He forgives the debt and then goes further, washing away the stain that wrongdoing leaves behind. Hiding keeps us in the dark; confessing brings us into the light.
Whatever you have been carrying, name it to Him this morning, plainly. He is already faithful.
